cc:Work.dc:title: Box - BayonetBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Round box made from layers with twist on top
Glue together - all outside rings to the bottom, all inside rings to the top.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes BayonetBox --diameter 90 --lugs 6 --alignment_pins 2 --outside 1 --thickness 6 --burn 0.05 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes BayonetBox --diameter --lugs --alignment_pins --thickness --burn --reference --labels
